summary.one_liner: OpenAGI is a Python package for creating and sharing AI agents, originally built to supply agents for the AIOS platform and now superseded by the Cerebrum SDK for that purpose.
summary.what_it_does: OpenAGI is a Python package for building AI agents. Each agent lives in its own folder under pyopenagi/agents, organized by author and agent name, with an agent.py file for execution logic, a config.json for settings, and a meta_requirements.txt listing dependencies. Developers can add custom tool files to their agent folder or use external tools that OpenAGI provides. The included interact.py script can upload a locally developed agent to the shared repository or download other developers' agents to inspect them. The README also links the package to the OpenAGI research paper, "When LLM Meets Domain Experts," presented at NeurIPS 2023. The README notes that agents for AIOS should now be built with Cerebrum, the newer SDK that connects to the AIOS kernel.
use_cases: Creating a new LLM agent in Python
Sharing a locally built agent with others
Downloading and reviewing other developers' agents
Adding custom tools to an agent
Reproducing the OpenAGI NeurIPS 2023 research work
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (the README leaves the URL blank)
notable: Standard agent folder layout (agent.py, config.json, meta_requirements.txt) under pyopenagi/agents/<author>/<agent_name>
Built-in upload and download commands via interact.py to share agents
Ships with external tools that agents can call
Companion code to a NeurIPS 2023 paper on LLMs with domain experts
caveats: The README says agents for AIOS should be migrated to Cerebrum, the newer SDK, so this package is not the recommended path for AIOS work
Setup for external tools is covered only by a reference to a separate guide, not described in the README
The README gives no license information and the git clone URL is missing
